name: Fukigen na Natsumi-san
source:
Main character has an ideal pale skin sister-in-love who comes as if from a fairy tale. But she has a secret that no one knows. And one day it springs into intimate relations with her brother-in-law.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
